name: io.github.thingery/thingery
description: Open item database and MCP server for AI agents to list, find, and trade second-hand goods.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string the stdio server queries (self-host). Defaults to postgres://thingery:thingery@localhost:5432/thingery when unset; without a reachable database, tools return errors.

environmentVariables.name: THINGERY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Seller API key (thg_...) enabling write tools in stdio mode. Optional: without it the server runs read-only public tools.
